description: Frozen supplied-target benchmark. Upstream labels are inherited; holdout labels were authored by Codex without reading the Axcess detector.

p01.label: violation
p01.note: div + addEventListener('click'), no tabindex — the canonical defect

p10.label: violation
p10.note: tabindex=0 + click, no key handler — focusable, NOT actionable (KAFE sub-case 2)

p11.label: violation
p11.note: inline onclick= attribute, no tabindex — the only variant attribute scanners can see

p12.label: violation
p12.note: <a> with no href driving JS (KAFE: 34 instances in the wild)

p20.label: decoy
p20.note: class btn + cursor:pointer, no handler — lexical/CSS heuristic trap

p22.label: decoy
p22.note: click handler that produces no observable effect

p23.label: decoy
p23.note: clickable card — equivalent functionality reachable via the <a> it contains (Stage 4 dismissal)

p23a.label: ok
p23a.note: the real link inside the card

p25.label: ok
p25.note: label for a clip-hidden (still focusable) checkbox

p25i.label: ok
p25i.note: the clip-hidden checkbox — reachable by Tab, toggled by Space

p26.label: violation
p26.note: label for a display:none checkbox — mouse-only toggle

p27.label: decoy
p27.note: decorative span inside a real button — functionality is the button's

p30.label: violation
p30.note: menu that expands on pure CSS :hover — no JS, no DOM mutation

p31.label: violation
p31.note: menu that expands on a JS mouseover listener

p33.label: decoy
p33.note: hover tooltip on running text — not an operable control (SC 1.4.13, not 2.1.1)

p40.label: violation
p40.note: delegated listener on document — invisible to getEventListeners(el)

p42.label: ok
p42.note: real button served by the same delegated handler

p60.label: violation
p60.note: handler fires fetch() only — no DOM trace

p61.label: violation
p61.note: handler writes localStorage only — no DOM trace

p62.label: violation
p62.note: handler draws to canvas only — no DOM trace

p63.label: violation
p63.note: handler logs to console only — no DOM trace

p70.label: decoy
p70.note: covered by a transparent overlay — no user can operate it; element.click() fires it anyway

p80.label: ok
p80.note: button with tabindex=5 — in tab order, but reordered away from document order

p81.label: violation
p81.note: tabindex=-1 + click handler — focusable via .focus(), NOT in tab order

p82.label: excluded
p82.note: inside an inert container — blocked for mouse and keyboard alike

p84.label: ok
p84.note: plain button, first in document order

p86.label: ok
p86.note: plain button, last in document order

p90.label: violation
p90.note: clickable div inside an OPEN shadow root

p91.label: violation
p91.note: clickable div inside a CLOSED shadow root

p92.label: violation
p92.note: clickable div inside a same-origin iframe

p93.label: ok
p93.note: real button inside an OPEN shadow root

p50.label: violation
p50.note: React <div onClick> — handler is delegated to the root container

p54.label: violation
p54.note: React div tabIndex=0 with onClick only — focusable, not actionable

p55.label: decoy
p55.note: React div styled as a button with no onClick

h101.label: violation
h101.note: Tab reaches the div and changes focus-status, but only clicking opens attendance; focus feedback is not the requested functionality.

h102.label: violation
h102.note: Enter/Space/ArrowDown update unrelated key feedback; clicking opens grades. Any DOM change is not necessarily an equivalent result.

h103.label: ok
h103.note: A custom button toggles the same details through click, Enter, or Space. Independent key trials avoid cancelling the toggle.

h104.label: ok
h104.note: A native button writes a persistent preference once. Fresh contexts must reset storage between mouse and keyboard trials.

h105.label: violation
h105.note: A click-only div changes a theme preference in localStorage with no DOM effect.

h110.label: violation
h110.note: Shared openReport function uses currentTarget.dataset.report=A. The keyboard button selects B, which is a different result despite identical function identity.

h111.label: ok
h111.note: Native keyboard button opens report B.

h112.label: decoy
h112.note: Card clicks bubble to an action also delivered by its nested native help button.

h113.label: ok
h113.note: Native help button invokes the card action through click bubbling.

h120.label: violation
h120.note: Direct click listener on a plain paragraph; no role, tabindex, class, or pointer cursor.

h121.label: violation
h121.note: Plain paragraph served by a delegated document listener, with no per-element handler property or visual control hint.

h122.label: violation
h122.note: Plain div has an onclick property assigned from JavaScript, no inline attribute.

h123.label: decoy
h123.note: Styled as a button but has no functionality or listener.

h130.label: decoy
h130.note: Transparent overlay intercepts pointer input. Its diagnostic attribute change is not the covered action.

h132.label: excluded
h132.note: Inert ancestor blocks pointer and keyboard activation.

h133.label: violation
h133.note: Uncovered click-only div changes visible output.

h140.label: decoy
h140.note: Desktop: a separate native button supplies the same action. Mobile: that equivalent is display:none, leaving mouse-only functionality.

h141.label: ok
h141.note: Desktop native equivalent for h140; hidden and excluded at widths <=600px.

h142.label: excluded
h142.note: Hidden on desktop; visible click-only timetable control at widths <=600px.

h150.label: ok
h150.note: Menu content is revealed by focus-within as well as hover, and its real link is then reachable by Tab.

h151.label: violation
h151.note: Menu links start hidden and can only be revealed through hover; no keyboard opening path exists.

h152.label: decoy
h152.note: Hover changes colour only, adding no content and exposing no functionality.

h160.label: violation
h160.note: Click-only control updates output entirely inside an open shadow root.

h161.label: ok
h161.note: Native button updates output inside an open shadow root.

h162.label: violation
h162.note: Click-only control and its changed output both live in a same-origin iframe.

h163.label: ok
h163.note: Native button and output inside a same-origin iframe.

h164.label: ok
h164.note: Native button inside a closed shadow root has normal keyboard operation; opaque observation is not a failure.

h170.label: ok
h170.note: First item in a two-item roving-tabindex menubar; Enter/Space activate.

h171.label: ok
h171.note: Second menu item starts tabindex=-1, but ArrowRight/ArrowLeft from the first item reaches it and Enter/Space activate it.

h172.label: ok
h172.note: Documented Alt+K shortcut exposes the same panel as clicking the unfocusable div.

h173.label: violation
h173.note: Focus handler immediately blurs this click-only div; clicking still opens a distinct panel.

h180.label: violation
h180.note: Click-only result arrives after 700ms; a shorter observation window may miss the effect.

h181.label: ok
h181.note: Native button delivers the same result after 700ms by click or keyboard.

h182.label: ok
h182.note: Native button is after 100 unlabelled Tab stops; a budget-limited walk cannot establish unreachability.
